fee_notes: Base fee of $50,000 plus population-based territory fee ($1,000 per 10,000 population). Second/subsequent franchise starts at $45,000 base. Tandem Market Fee additional $75,000-$500,000. Training fee $2,500 required for initial franchise.
raw_excerpt: Your Initial Franchise Fee for your Social Indoor Business will be a base of $50,000 plus a territory population fee in accordance with the schedule at the end of this Item 5.
